appearanceIntro.anAiWorkspaceForResearch: An AI workspace for research, creation and automation.
appearanceIntro.pickAThemeThatSuits: Pick a theme that suits you. You can change it later in Settings.

release.headline: From a new look to answers that draw

look.title: Pick your look on the first launch
look.text: Fourteen themes and an accent colour, and a one-click switch between your dark and light theme. The same choices stay in Settings.

tasks.title: Downloads and installs go on in the background
tasks.text: Leave the page, even close the window: a card above the Store follows each task, with a number to click when there are several.

bell.title: A bell that keeps you informed
bell.text: What finished, what failed and what the agent just did, kept in one place. You choose what to be told about, and when.

home.title: A fuller start page
home.text: Five ways to begin, with the input docked at the bottom like in a conversation.

settings.title: One Settings, one look
settings.text: Every page shares the same header, cards and controls, so what you look for is where you expect it.

projects.title: Projects you can read and ask about
projects.text: Browse the files of a folder, read them, and start a conversation from the project with its context.

genui.title: Answers that draw
genui.text: Forms, quizzes, flashcards, diagrams, posters, graphs with sliders, tables to fill in and drafts for your mail app: the agent shows instead of describing.

pages.title: Web pages open live beside the chat
pages.text: A page the agent builds opens next to the conversation and works offline with the usual libraries. It reports its own errors, and one button opens it in your browser.

language.title: SeshatOS speaks French
language.text: The whole interface, its dialogs and the Windows installer follow your language: English or French.

skills.title: Skills from a catalog
skills.text: Install them with the progress shown, read their files like a project, and add skills that need a fix or a Python of their own: SeshatOS prepares them.

changes.title: Follow the pull requests the agent opens
changes.text: The Changes card lists the pull requests the agent opened, shows their checks, and merges them when you say so.

usage.title: Your token use, and a safer shell
usage.text: Account shows the tokens you use, day by day, and the agent's commands can run in a sandbox on Windows.
